task.description:
WF-03 Step 7 — DOC-UPDATER. Update documentation for ISS-0123 / GitHub #389 fix.

Required actions:
1. Update CHANGELOG.md — add an entry under the latest section:
   "### Fixed (ISS-0123 / GitHub #389 — DLQ table rename + audit trigger isolation)
    - Renamed `dead_letter_queue` → `dead_letter_items` across 22 source/test files (post-072 canonical name)
    - Wrapped `trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert` install in `obs05_dlq_test.zig` in a SAVEPOINT with errdefer ROLLBACK for unconditional cleanup
    - Added new tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py to detect legacy table names in src/ and tests/integration/
    - New regression tests: tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig (TC-ISS-0123-01 source-assertion + TC-ISS-0123-02 audit-insert smoke)
    - Migration 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql confirmed canonical"

2. Update docs/anti-patterns.md — add a new section:
   "### Anti-pattern: legacy table name in source/test after migration rename
   - Symptom: PostgreSQL C42703 "column does not exist" or "relation does not exist" after a migration renames a table
   - Detection: tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py scans src/**/*.zig and tests/integration/**/*.zig for legacy table names
   - Prevention: when renaming a table in a migration, also update every reference in src/ and tests/ in the SAME commit. The new linter will fail the build if any legacy reference returns."

3. Mark ISS-0123 as RESOLVED. Update docs/issues/ISS-0123.json:
   - status: "RESOLVED"
   - resolved_at: <current ISO8601 timestamp>
   - resolution: "Implemented fix on feature/WF03-gh389-20260802: renamed dead_letter_queue → dead_letter_items across 22 source/test files, wrapped obs05 trigger install in SAVEPOINT with errdefer ROLLBACK, added tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py linter, added tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig regression test. Validated: zig build/test/migrate all exit 0, 2/2 iss0123 tests pass, 14/14 TM tests pass, NFR benchmarks all green."

4. Update docs/requirements.yaml via reqctl.py if any requirements were affected (most likely none for an issue fix, but check).

5. Post a comment to GitHub issue #389: "<!-- rco-sync-ref: ISS-0123 -->\nResolved in PR #<PR-number>. Tests pass: 2/2 iss0123 + 14/14 TM. Migration 072 canonical, no more C42703 source_ref errors, no more P0001 audit-trigger leaks from obs05."

6. Commit and push:
   - git add -A
   - git commit -m "docs(WF03-gh389): update CHANGELOG, resolve ISS-0123, anti-pattern entry"
   - git push origin feature/WF03-gh389-20260802

When done:
- Set handoff status: "COMPLETED"
- Fill result.status: "PASS", result.summary: "Documentation updated for ISS-0123", result.artifacts_out: ["CHANGELOG.md", "docs/anti-patterns.md", "docs/issues/ISS-0123.json"], result.issues: [], result.next_action: "Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step Final) — PR, squash-merge, branch cleanup"
- Set completed_at to current ISO8601 timestamp
- Update handoffs/registry.json for the new handoff_id
- Append to handoffs/orchestrator.log
- IMPORTANT: registry.json must use open(..., encoding='utf-8'). Use \n (not CRLF).

Allowed commands: read_file, file_search, grep_search, run_in_terminal, create_file, replace_string_in_file, multi_replace_string_in_file, .venv\Scripts\python.exe for reqctl.py, git, gh (at C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe). NO zig build, NO source code edits.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the ISS-0123 fix
docs/anti-patterns.md has a new anti-pattern section about legacy table names after migration rename
docs/issues/ISS-0123.json status=RESOLVED, resolved_at set, resolution populated
GitHub issue #389 has a closing comment (use gh CLI, NOT comment that already exists)
Changes committed and pushed to feature/WF03-gh389-20260802
